purpose: Reader-facing connective sentence rendered BETWEEN the sign paragraph and the ruler-placement paragraph. Explains the mechanism (empty house -> cusp sign -> ruler planet -> planet's natal house) so the jump from A to B is legible. No approved V14 prose is modified; this is a new template row family with slot vocabulary.
review_status: needs_review — owner exact-wording approval required before serving

slots.sign: capitalized sign name from the cusp
slots.planet: display name with article: 'the Moon', 'the Sun', 'Mercury', 'Venus', 'Mars', 'Jupiter', 'Saturn', 'Uranus', 'Neptune', 'Pluto' — from the active ruler map (modern now, traditional when those rows land)
slots.topicN, topicM: short house-jurisdiction noun phrases; reuse/extend the existing fallback-vocab/empty-house-ruler-jurisdiction rows (e.g. 6 = 'daily work, routines, and health')

example_renders.case: empty 2nd, Cancer cusp, Moon in 6th (the user's first example)
example_renders.rendered_you: Your 2nd house is empty, and Cancer sits on its cusp. Cancer is ruled by the Moon, and in your chart the Moon lands in your 6th house. That is why your money story keeps running through daily work, routines, and health.
example_renders.note: topicN grammar: 'your money story' reads better than 'your money and what you value story' — recommend a second, possessive-safe vocab set (2 = 'money', see topic_vocab_short)

example_renders.case: empty/unoccupied 1st, Gemini rising, Mercury in 10th (the user's second example)
example_renders.rendered_you: Your rising sign is Gemini, which makes Mercury your chart ruler. In your chart Mercury lands in your 10th house, so the story of who you are gets worked out through career and public reputation.
